text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A group message on a letter?
...Wait, what's that about?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! I'll write letters to Sei-chan
and Grass-chan's families, and then—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And we will write a letter to your mother, Spe-chan.
So... something like a shared group letter?

I spot Special Week and the others in the cafeteria.
Come to think of it, the other day...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Right now, I'm thinking up
a very important master plan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If we write letters like this, I can introduce everyone
to Mom, and I thought it'd be super fun
if we all wrote together~!
choice_data_list: (So that was what she meant by her "plan.")

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that does sound lovely.
I wonder what Spe-chan will write about us?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, let's see!
"Grass-chan is always so dignified, and though
her running form is graceful, she's incredibly fast!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, my... fufu.
Your pure honesty is dazzling as always~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then, for Sei-chan...
"Sei-chan is bright and cheerful, a precious friend
who always brings warmth and eases the mood."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on, I never said I was in on this.
Please don't drag me in so casually~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"However, when she skips out on training,
it's quite an ordeal for all of us to track her down."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Texting or emailing is way more convenient, y'know.
No need to go through all this extra trouble...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, she sneaks into random nooks just like a cat,
so finding her is getting harder and harder by the day."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...So you're not backing down, huh!
If that's how you wanna play it, then I'll...

text_block_list.name: Sky & Grass
text_block_list.text: "Spe-chan has been eating far too much lately."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
P-Please, have mercy~~~?!
Mom's gonna cut down my care package allowances~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Sorry, my bad.
"Though half of that is a joke—Spe-chan's
bounding energy always cheers us up."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
See? Letters really help give your honest feelings
that extra little push forward!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
Sei-chan, thank you so much for the sweet message!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Good grief.
Spe-chan's smile really is something else.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Grandpa,
Thanks for watching my mock race and calling me.
I couldn't say it back then, but I was really happy."

A few days later—
A reply arrived from Seiun Sky's grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Grandpa's penmanship is top-notch as always.
Wait, these smudges in the ink are—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Is that letter
from your grandpa, Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa, hold it right there.
Eyes off! Please submit your request through my agency~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see... But it must be a wonderful letter!
I can tell just by looking at your face, Sei-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haah... As expected of the Letter Meister, I surrender!
Just as you said, it was a super-warm, tearjerker of a letter!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's that, little letter?
"Write back soon"? Well, guess I have no choice~?

text_block_list.name: Grandpa Sky's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Sky,
You don't need to thank me—your grandpa is the one
who gets all his energy from you!"

text_block_list.name: Grandpa Sky's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Just watching you run fills your grandpa with boundless
joy and vigor! All you need to do is keep doing your best
in your own way, all right?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad Sei-chan looks happy.
I guess the letter operation was a success!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty then! Now I'll go ahead
and read the letter from my mom♪

text_block_list.name: Mom's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Spe,
A collaborative letter sure is a fun idea.
It brings me great joy knowing you have so many wonderful friends."

text_block_list.name: Mom's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The kindness and unique spirit of your friends truly
shone through. Cherish these bonds, always.
May happiness always find you, my dear Spe."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Mom.
Together with all my precious friends and rivals...
I'm giving it my wicked-best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Mom.
Together with all my precious friends and rivals...
I'm giving it my wicked-best!

text_block_list.name: Mom's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"P.S.
That said, it sounds like you've been overeating lately,
so I'll be cutting back on the carrots I send you."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: WHY THOOOOOUGH~~~~~?!
